name: Drapeau belge / Belgische vlag
source: Official Guide to Protocol in Belgium: the national flag measures 2.6 m tall for each 3 m wide (13:15), in three equal vertical bands, black at the hoist. The tricolour was placed in the Constitution on 23 January 1831; the vertical orientation and the black-at-hoist order were settled on 12 October 1831. A 2:3 civil version is in common use, including by ministries, but is not the constitutional ratio.

black.specified_as: Pantone Black / CMYK 0-0-0-100 (Official Guide to Protocol)

yellow.specified_as: Pantone 115 / CMYK 0-8.5-79-0 (Official Guide to Protocol); hex #FDDA24

red.specified_as: Pantone 032 / CMYK 0-94-87-0 (Official Guide to Protocol); hex #EF3340. Other flag manuals cite PMS 116 or 114 for the yellow and 186 or 185 for the red; the Protocol guide is the one this sheet follows.

note: The simplest flag in Tier A, and the one that shows the element system does not need a special case for the easy majority: three equal bands is one element.
